entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-09
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • what happened to Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp 5.0.0-1.25259.101 #81616
  • Certain file-based app restore errors do not surface in the editor #81611
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `roslyn/features/dictionary-expressions` can't be mirrored to Azdo fast forward branch #81610
  • RefactoringError in Visual Studio when adding a tuple in a standard for-next-loop #81608
  • Errors are not reported in Razor files #81603
  • Interaction between AllowNull and MemberNotNull raises a false warning when object initializer is used #81594
    18.3
  • MSBuildWorksapce doesn't handle multi-targeted unloadable projects correctly when resolving references #81589

Closed

  • `SyntaxFacts.IsOnHeader` failure while typing a new expression member in a new file #81563
    18.3
  • "Automatically format when typing" is formatting immediately after writing "else" causing incorrect formatting. #81602
  • BUG: in VB.NET using Path Method #81600
  • Roslyn crashes on bad extension property #81590
  • Roslyn should move back to calling IVsRunningDocumentTable.Advise on the UI thread #81459
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build feature.debugger.stackAnalysis-11308.44 #81588
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-11308.91 #81587

Created

  • Merge main into features/collection-expression-arguments #81615

    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Extension indexers: allow and resolve extension indexers #81607
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Indexers
  • Add specific error for extension parameter usage in static members #81606
    Area-IDE
  • Reduce allocations in PENamedTypeSymbol.GetMemberTypesPrivate #81605
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Improve error recovery in top level statements #81604
    Area-Compilers
  • Remove smart rename lightup #81598
    Area-IDE
  • Merge main into features/collection-expression-arguments #81596
    Needs UX Triage, Needs API Review, VSCode
  • Fix trivial spelling mistake #81595
    Area-IDE, Community
  • [WIP] Consolidate ExternalAccess libraries #81593
    Area-IDE, Needs API Review, VSCode
  • Centralize recognized feature flags #81591
    Area-Compilers

Merged

  • Move IDE code over to C# 14. #79835
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Update Roslyn.Diagnostics.Analyzers #81599

  • Remove unnecessary lightup code #81597
    VSCode, Next
  • Switch the fetch of the Running Document Table to the UI thread again #81566
    Area-IDE, Next

Updated

  • Merge vs-extension-testing into Roslyn #81565
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Simplify parsing of variable declarators. #81454

  • Fix CS1003 error message when expression follows identifier without '=' #81285
    Area-Compilers, VSCode
  • Collection arguments: CollectionBuilder elements parameter last #78549
    VSCode
